question: What is the name of only lake formed by a meteorite in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Lonar__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Lonar Lake is a saline lake located in Buldhana district, Maharashtra.
 
• It is formed after a meteorite impact led to crater formation.
 
• It has been designated as a Ramsar site by Wetland International in the year 2020.
